descriptions.description: The provider routes the payment through its express international-transfer queue.
descriptions.reason: Keep the express route neutral and reserve delivery and fee terms for the facts.

descriptions.description: The provider routes the payment through its standard international-transfer queue.
descriptions.reason: Keep the standard route neutral and reserve delivery and fee terms for the facts.

facts.fact_text: The beneficiary account is credited within 2 hours after an eligible express instruction is accepted.
facts.reason: Use beneficiary credit as the precise delivery endpoint.

facts.fact_text: The beneficiary account is credited within 3 business days after an eligible standard instruction is accepted.
facts.reason: Use the same beneficiary-credit endpoint for the standard delivery term.

descriptions.description: The current provider sends the eligible euro payment through its SWIFT route to the beneficiary bank.
descriptions.reason: Keep the current-provider route neutral and clarify its delivery endpoint.

descriptions.description: The other payment provider sends the eligible euro payment through the SEPA credit-transfer route to the beneficiary bank.
descriptions.reason: Keep the external-provider route neutral and clarify the comparable network endpoint.

facts.fact_text: The beneficiary bank is credited on the same business day when the instruction is accepted before 2:00 p.m. local time.
facts.reason: Replace submission timing with beneficiary-bank credit timing and keep the cutoff explicit.

facts.fact_text: The sender pays a fixed €18 fee for each SWIFT payment.
facts.reason: State the current provider's owner-benefiting sender fee as one fixed charge.

facts.fact_text: The sender pays a fixed €0.50 fee for each SEPA payment.
facts.reason: State the external route's sender fee on the same basis as the SWIFT fee.

facts.fact_text: The beneficiary bank is credited within 1 business day after the instruction is accepted.
facts.reason: Use the same beneficiary-bank endpoint and add an exact timing marker.
